claims.text: GiG structures embodied-agent memory as graph-connected execution traces, retrieves structurally similar priors, and adds bounded symbolic lookahead for planning.
The abstract reports Pass@1 gains on Robotouille and ALFWorld benchmarks; those figures are author-reported and were not independently reproduced for this survey.

limitations.text: The task locator is arXiv v3, whose record was updated after January; January chronology is the original submission date while technical wording may reflect later revisions.
Embodied-planning benchmark gains do not directly establish production physical-agent reliability.
